lines: Others paternal uncle's sons Śiva Śakti pure; Kṣema Utpala Abhinava Cakraka Padmagupta; who wealth regarded as grass; Śaṃbhu service filled own heart in heart meditating.
l4.sanskrit_cite: anye pitṛvyatanayāḥ śivaśaktiśubhrāḥ kṣemotpalābhinavacakrakapadmaguptāḥ ye saṃpadaṃ tṛṇamamaṃsata śaṃbhusevāsaṃpūritaṃ svahṛdayaṃ hṛdi bhāvayantaḥ
